zh: 两国元首同意保持高层交往，推动双边关系持续稳定发展。
en: The two heads of state agreed to maintain high-level exchanges and keep bilateral relations stable.

zh: 双方签署了关于气候变化合作的谅解备忘录。
en: The two sides signed a memorandum of understanding on climate cooperation.

zh: 峰会期间，各国领导人就地区安全与经济复苏交换了意见。
en: During the summit, leaders exchanged views on regional security and economic recovery.

zh: 双边贸易额去年突破千亿美元大关，创下历史新高。
en: Bilateral trade surpassed one hundred billion dollars last year, a record high.

zh: 我们反对贸易保护主义，主张维护以规则为基础的多边贸易体制。
en: We oppose trade protectionism and stand for a rules-based multilateral trading system.

zh: 两国将互免签证，方便更多游客和商务人士往来。
en: The two countries will waive visa requirements to make travel easier for tourists and business people.

zh: 双方同意建立热线机制，及时沟通处理海上突发事件。
en: The two sides agreed to set up a hotline to handle maritime incidents promptly.

zh: 这次会议通过了未来十年双边合作的规划纲要。
en: The meeting adopted a ten-year plan for bilateral cooperation.

zh: 在例行记者会上，发言人就有关报道回答了中外记者提问。
en: At the regular press conference, the spokesperson took questions from Chinese and foreign reporters.

zh: 多国代表在联合国大会上就发展融资问题阐述了各自立场。
en: Many delegates set out their positions on development financing at the United Nations General Assembly.

zh: 两国央行续签了本币互换协议，便利双边贸易结算。
en: The two central banks renewed their currency swap agreement to facilitate trade settlement.

zh: 大使在演讲中说，友谊需要在持续的民间交往中不断加深。
en: As the ambassador said in his speech, friendship deepens through constant people-to-people exchange.

zh: 代表团参观了当地港口和工业园区，深入探讨物流合作。
en: The delegation toured local ports and industrial parks to explore logistics cooperation.

zh: 峰会闭幕，与会各方发表了包含二十八项共识的联合宣言。
en: The summit closed with a joint declaration containing twenty-eight points of consensus.

zh: 双方决定互设文化中心，推动语言教学和艺术交流。
en: The two sides will open cultural centers in each other's countries to promote language teaching and the arts.

zh: 该国际组织呼吁各方保持克制，通过对话解决分歧。
en: The international organization called on all parties to exercise restraint and resolve differences through dialogue.

zh: 首轮磋商气氛友好，双方同意下个月在北京继续会谈。
en: The first round of consultations was friendly, and both sides agreed to meet in Beijing next month.

zh: 我们欢迎更多外国企业前来投资，分享发展的机遇。
en: We welcome more foreign companies to invest here and share in the opportunities.

zh: 援建的学校和医院已投入使用，惠及当地数万民众。
en: The schools and hospitals built with aid are now in use, benefiting tens of thousands of local people.

zh: 两国青年交流项目启动，首批一百名学生将互访学习。
en: A youth exchange program has launched; the first hundred students will visit each other's countries.
